north_star: Win with a fully working seeded judge journey; anything unreachable in that journey is not complete.

requirements.competition_requirement: Users hold different roles per event and authorization prevents cross-role access.
requirements.demo_step: Seeded chair opens organiser dashboard; reviewer is limited to assigned review; speaker opens own checklist.

requirements.competition_requirement: Configure criteria, weights and review rounds; chair retains final decision authority.
requirements.demo_step: Seeded event shows Round 1, Round 2, criteria and an accepted proposal's decision history.

requirements.competition_requirement: Acceptance creates a speaker-facing onboarding checklist.
requirements.demo_step: Chair accepts the proposal; the speaker checklist appears without duplicate tasks.

requirements.competition_requirement: Tasks require profile, response, acknowledgement and restricted asset evidence.
requirements.demo_step: Speaker completes acknowledgement and sees overdue/upload work ordered next.

requirements.competition_requirement: Dashboard counts link to filtered records and reconcile exactly.
requirements.demo_step: Chair clicks outstanding tasks and conflicts; card totals equal the visible rows.

requirements.competition_requirement: Queue reusable reminders safely with delivery deduplication.
requirements.demo_step: Seeded reminder appears in the mail queue and replay does not create another receipt.

requirements.competition_requirement: Detect speaker and room overlap and block unsafe release.
requirements.demo_step: Seeded WIP schedule shows blocking conflicts; release is attempted, blocked, then resolved before release.

requirements.competition_requirement: Only explicitly published records appear on public schedule surfaces.
requirements.demo_step: After release, the public schedule and embed show the released placement while WIP remains organiser data.

requirements.competition_requirement: Calendar updates retain UID, increment sequence and express cancellation.
requirements.demo_step: Judge opens the released ICS endpoint and updates a session without creating a duplicate UID.

requirements.competition_requirement: Provide responsive accessible event-scoped read-only embeds.
requirements.demo_step: Judge loads the public embed URL and sees released sessions in a responsive card layout.

requirements.competition_requirement: Public CFP supports text, long text, select, multiselect, boolean, URL and file fields with requiredness, help text, choices, ordering, category association, and draft/resume.
requirements.demo_step: Judge opens the seeded CFP, sees the seven AIE question types, saves a draft, resumes it, and proceeds to review.

requirements.competition_requirement: Idempotent organizer-triggered synchronization with external identities, retries, and reconciliation.
requirements.demo_step: Judge opens the seeded sync card, sees create/update/no-op items, a failed item, and a successful retry without resending the successful item.

requirements.competition_requirement: Surface unavailable integration credentials honestly instead of pretending synchronization is connected.
requirements.demo_step: Organiser dashboard displays the connection status and credential-blocked state when no credential is configured.

gaps.shortest_path: Add conditional question visibility and answer routing after the protected P0 journey is stable.
